title: Print Window Weighted Spacing
description: Replace inconsistent window spacing on cover pages with one canonical gap plus weight-normalized row/column/stack sizing. Implement SemioWindowStack and weighted SemioWindowRowTwo/Three macros.
summary:
Generalized the cover-page window layout system from a flat 2-level stack+fixed-arity-row into a recursive window-arrangement tree, and separately fixed 3 chained TOC/register bugs (background task) that had blocked zwischenbericht from building at all.

Layout generalization (print/tex/semio-window.sty, %region WindowArrangement, replacing the old %region WindowRow):
- Replaced the single global g_semio_window_stack_current_height_dim + l_semio_window_row_group_bool skip-guard with local, TeX-group-scoped pending-height state (l_semio_window_pending_height_dim/bool, l_semio_window_in_item_bool) propagated via \semio_window_item_provide:n (also resets l_semio_window_height_set_bool per-item to avoid a leaked-true bug across sibling items) and consumed via \semio_window_arrangement_height_adopt: (replaces \semio_window_row_height_sync:, now called by Window, kind-windows, WindowRow, and WindowColumn alike).
- Dropped the `row` keyval on Window (auto-detected now via l_semio_window_in_item_bool) and its 3 read sites (semio_block_sep_before/after, generic_begin's tcb-path branch).
- Deleted the two-pass natural-measure fallback entirely (dead in all production usage): SemioWindowMeasureBegin/End, semio_window_measure_begin:/end:, l_semio_window_measure_bool, semio@window@row@measure, semio@window@row@h@max@set/update, semio@window@row@chrome@h@ensure (already-dead), semio@window@stretch@height/SemioWindowStretchHeightValue, l_semio_window_row_group_bool. Simplified semio_window_content_validate: and semio_window_textfit_target_set: accordingly.
- Added \semio_window_weights_to_dims:NnN, one N-ary weight-proportional dimension splitter replacing both the old height-only stack-prepare and the width-only 2/3-hardcoded row-col-width logic. Fixed a subtle bug in it: \semio@window@gap is a \newlength (skip/glue register, not a plain dimen) — referencing it directly inside \dim_eval:n caused a silent runaway-argument scan (surfacing as a much-later "Illegal unit of measure" error); fixed by bridging through \the exactly like the pre-existing \SemioWindowStackPrepare code already did.
- Added new public API: \WindowItem[weight]{content} (item registration, local-seq-based, list-based not fixed-arity), WindowRow (N children, divides width, all children share full height), WindowColumn (N children, divides height, all children share full width), WindowArrangement (root, height key defaulting to \textheight). Arbitrary nesting depth/child count, not capped at 2/3 columns. Verified 3-level nesting (Column > Row > Column, with text-size=fit) compiles cleanly via debug fixtures.
- Migrated \makecoverpages in print/tex/semio-components.sty to the new WindowArrangement/WindowColumn/WindowRow/WindowItem API, preserving every existing conditional-row guard; fixed the Arbeitsprobe image height calc to reference the new l_semio_window_pending_height_dim.

TOC/register fix (background task, same file): semio_window_toc_aux_line:nnn called nonexistent \str_trim_spaces:N (fixed to \tl_trim_spaces:N); a label-seq push used \exp_args:NV wrongly on the seq variable itself (fixed to \exp_args:NNV); semio_window_toc_seq_sanitize: used a nonexistent \tl_if_in_p:Nn predicate (fixed to nested \tl_if_in:NnTF). These only surfaced when \maketableofcontents has non-empty entries (zwischenbericht), which forschungsbericht's lack of \maketableofcontents was masking.

Verified: `bun ./script.ts build report forschungsbericht zwischenbericht` (light+dark, 6 PDFs) all exit 0 with no LaTeX errors; cover pages confirmed single-page via page-break markers in the .log; a standalone 3-level nested WindowColumn/WindowRow/WindowColumn debug fixture compiles without error.
